answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lagoon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
